name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
released_note: BF16 repo created 2026-10-05; Unsloth GGUF and Ollama tag 2026-10-23.

based_on.note: NVIDIA post-trained it from Google's Gemma 4 E4B (the card's architecture row reads 'Gemma-4-E4B') and ships it under its own name.

architecture.anatomy: 8B parameters, 4B effective (Gemma 4 E-series per-layer embeddings), per the NVIDIA card

summary: NVIDIA's small local assistant model, post-trained from Gemma 4 E4B: 8B parameters (4B effective), text in and out. NVIDIA's card gives 64K input / 64K output; Ollama lists a 128K window. About 5 GB at 4-bit; Ollama's tag is 7.2-7.9 GB.

practical_baseline.reason: No reported or measured run recorded yet.
